A '''special missions platoon''' was a formation in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
Composed of thirty-eight men, a special missions platoon was made up of two [[sharpshooter squad]]s, an [[engineering squad]], and a [[heavy weapons squad]]. These squads were cross-attached with each other to form three roughly equal squads of sharpshooters, engineers, and heavy weapons specialists. Special missions platoons conducted operations that required elite personnel, rather than standard military maneuvers.<ref name="ISB" />

Special missions platoons undertook "[[political gain operation]]s," where the unit conducted terrorist operations on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] where sympathies were closer to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] than to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Such operations would result in the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] requesting assistance, which was provided in the form of new troop deployments. These troops would arrest suspected and known Rebel sympathizers. The attacks would then cease, fostering the image that the Alliance was behind the terrorist attacks.<ref name="ISB" />

==History==
A special missions platoon named [[Kal'Shebbol's Fury]] operated as part of [[Moff Sarne's forces|Moff Kentor Sarne's forces]]. They were deployed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] during the [[Battle of Kathol System]].<ref name="Endgame">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Endgame (adventure)|book=Endgame}}</ref>
